title: TEDxTokyo — 人口減少時代の日本の選択 (Japan's Choices in an Era of Population Decline)
description: TEDxTokyo talk on the social and economic consequences of Japan's shrinking population: declining birth rates, rural depopulation (地方消滅), immigration policy debate, robotics and automation as responses, and what kind of society Japan might build by 2050. Abstract reasoning, policy vocabulary, and speaker's personal conviction make this genuine N1-level listening.
creator: TEDxTokyo
